title: Meetings & Events Training Note: The Food and Beverage Minimum and the Minimum Shortfall
content:
Every Meetings & Events package carries a food and beverage minimum. When the contract's food and beverage revenue, before service charge and sales tax, is below the package's food and beverage minimum, the difference is charged as a minimum shortfall.

## The rule

- **What is measured.** Food and beverage revenue is the total of the contract's package charges and its additional hosted bar hour charges, before service charge and sales tax.
- **The shortfall.** The shortfall is the package's food and beverage minimum less the food and beverage revenue, when that revenue is below the minimum; when the revenue is at or above the minimum, the shortfall is zero.
- **Service charge and tax on the shortfall.** The shortfall bears the service charge only when the package's shortfall bears the service charge, and sales tax only when the package's shortfall bears sales tax.
- **What does not count.** Room rental, fees and audio-visual charges never count toward the minimum; only the food and beverage revenue described above is measured.
- **Status and frequency.** A shortfall is charged only on a contract whose status is completed, once per contract.

## Questions answered

**Does room rental help a contract reach its minimum?**
No. Room rental never counts toward the minimum.

**Do additional hosted bar hours count?**
Yes. Additional hosted bar hour charges form part of food and beverage revenue, together with the package charges.

**Is the minimum compared before or after the service charge?**
Before. Both the minimum and the revenue measured against it are before service charge and sales tax.

**Can a shortfall be charged while the event is still ahead?**
No. It is charged only once the contract's status is completed.

## Hypothetical illustrations

| Food and beverage minimum | Package charges | Additional hosted bar hour charges | Food and beverage revenue | Minimum shortfall |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5,000.00 | 4,250.00 | 0.00 | 4,250.00 | 750.00 |
| 5,000.00 | 4,250.00 | 840.00 | 5,090.00 | 0.00 |
| 12,000.00 | 12,000.00 | 0.00 | 12,000.00 | 0.00 |
| 2,500.00 | 1,935.00 | 0.00 | 1,935.00 | 565.00 |

In the first row, a room rental of 750.00 charged on the same contract would leave the shortfall at 750.00, rental never counting toward the minimum.
